title: ESP32 agent skill frontmatter
description: The YAML block at the top of every skills/<name>/SKILL.md. tools/validate_skills.py implements these rules without a JSON Schema dependency; this file is the readable statement of the same contract.

name.description: Must equal the directory name, so a skill cannot be moved without its identity moving with it.

description.description: Starts with 'Use when' because this line is the routing signal: it is what the harness matches a user request against.

license.description: Every skill ships its own LICENSE.txt; the field keeps the frontmatter honest about it.

version.description: Optional per-skill version, for a skill that changes more often than the repository.

tools.description: Comma-separated tool names the skill expects, as the harness spells them.

metadata.description: Free-form provenance: origin, upstream link, verification level.
